title: Nokia plans to sell its AI-driven RAN platform, developed with Nvidia, to mobile operators by 2027, aiming for a 100% increase in spectrum efficiency by 2028 (Paula Doenecke/Bloomberg)
summary: Paula Doenecke / Bloomberg: Nokia plans to sell its AI-driven RAN platform, developed with Nvidia, to mobile operators by 2027, aiming for a 100% increase in spectrum efficiency by 2028 — Nokia Oyj says it developed the first commercial artificial intelligence driven radio access network platform together with Nvidia Corp …
